VIPCOO VS2 PRO Dual Motor Electric Scooter – Power & Range Without Compromise
Tired of electric scooters with short range and weak motors that struggle on hills or lose power halfway through your commute? The VIPCOO VS2 PRO is built for riders who demand stronger acceleration, longer battery life, and real-world performance for both city commuting and light off-road adventures.

48V 18.2Ah High-Capacity Battery – Extended Riding Range
Equipped with a 48V 18.2Ah lithium battery, the VIPCOO VS2 PRO delivers significantly longer ride time compared to standard commuter scooters. Whether you're commuting to work, running errands, or exploring on weekends, this upgraded battery reduces charging frequency and eliminates range anxiety.

Dual 1000W Motors – Powerful Acceleration & Hill Climbing
Powered by dual 48V 1000W motors with torque ≥25N·m, paired with dual 48V 23A controllers, this scooter offers:

Smooth single-motor mode for daily commuting

Full dual-motor mode for steep hills and rough terrain

Top speed up to 57 km/h (35 mph) in unlocked mode (based on 70 kg / 154 lbs rider)

Strong torque ensures faster starts, better hill climbing, and improved adaptability to complex road conditions.
US Max speed is 20-35 mph, UK/EU Max speed is 15.5-35mph.
Freely unlock the speed limit when riding on private roads for enhanced performance.

Four-Brake System – Dual Disc + Electronic Braking
Ride with confidence thanks to a quadruple braking system:

Front & rear mechanical disc brakes with power cut-off

Left & right electronic brakes

This combination delivers faster response, shorter braking distance, and improved safety in emergency situations.

Front & Rear Swing Arm Spring Suspension
The dual swing arm spring suspension system absorbs shocks effectively, improving stability and ride comfort. Combined with 10-inch (10×2.5-6.5) all-terrain tubeless vacuum tires, it handles:

City asphalt roads

Gravel paths

Light off-road trails

Enjoy smoother rides with reduced vibration and better traction.

Durable Anti-Rust Steel Frame
Built with a reinforced iron frame processed through electrophoresis and powder coating, the structure resists rust, deformation, and heavy daily use. Designed for high-frequency commuting and light off-road durability.

NFC Smart Display – Keyless Unlock
The integrated center display features NFC card unlocking, allowing you to start your scooter with a simple tap—no keys, no password input.

KM/Mile switching

5-minute auto power-off

Cruise control (default off)

Trip & total mileage reset

Zero start

Fault code display

Gear indicator display

Push-assist mode

Perfect for beginners and experienced riders alike.

Full Lighting System – 360° Visibility
Stay visible day and night with a complete lighting setup:

High-brightness front headlight

Handlebar turn signals

Brake light & tail light

Enhanced visibility ensures safer night riding and improved road awareness.

Secure Folding Mechanism with Double Safety Lock
The folding stem features a secondary safety lock with a dual-latch structure. It prevents accidental unfolding when stored in a car trunk and ensures added safety during rides.

Optional Seat – Ride Your Way
The seat is available as an optional accessory. Choose:

Stand-up riding for agility and sport feel

Add a seat for enhanced comfort during longer commutes

Upgrade Your Ride Today
Stop settling for weak motors and short battery life. The VIPCOO VS2 PRO Dual Motor Electric Scooter delivers the power, range, safety, and versatility modern riders demand.
